# Charlotta & Shirley

- [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) — Friend of — [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) — admires her and confides in her · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v3 ch.Revelation P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dresses in a new pale green dress and converses with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md) before leaving for [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) then walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they eat lunch and visit with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth in the garden. Afterward, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) set out to pick early strawberries for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P37](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0037)_

> Charlotta the Fourth expresses concern to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Miss Lavendar's unusual despondency and apathy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises to come stay for a week during her vacation to help cheer Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) up. Meanwhile, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) bond over their shared experiences with imaginary dream-people before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and helps Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for her reunion with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). The two eagerly wait in anticipation as Mr. [Irving](../character/irving.md) arrives at the house in the evening.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P47](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0047), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) excitedly prepare for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives, reconnecting with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before entering to meet [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). After an anxious wait in the kitchen, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) watch [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) walk in the garden together, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to happily predict a wedding.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P73](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0073)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for college while helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) plan her wedding, receiving visits and commentary from [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. She discusses the romance of the marriage with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before discovering [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) together in the garden. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) later visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on love, change, and her own future.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for Miss Lavendar's wedding to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). After a joyful ceremony and farewell send-off, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a quiet, romantic moment together outside the stone house as a new chapter of life begins.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0039)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant summer in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) filled with visits from friends like [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), though she misses [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and deals with questions about their altered relationship. During a stay at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on growing up and admits to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) that she refused Gilbert's desire for something beyond friendship.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People

_Sources: [v3 ch.People P0](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0000), [v3 ch.People P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 ch.People P19](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0019), [v3 ch.People P26](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0026)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and is shocked to hear from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. She spends a grief-stricken night realizing her true feelings for him. In the morning, [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) Buote passes by and informs her that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

_Sources: [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025), [v3 ch.Revelation P27](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0027)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her wedding plans and guest list with Mrs. Lynde and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). In the following days, guests arrive to celebrate, including Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), who presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with Miss Patty's china dogs. On the eve of her wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Matthew's grave before joining [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on a walk home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P0](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P57](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0057)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up happily on her wedding day at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and reflects on her life in her childhood room. Family and friends gather to prepare and celebrate, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are married in the orchard. Following a joyful reception, the newlyweds leave for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. [Mary](../character/mary-joe.md) while their guests remain to comfort [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES
